name: G9 T3 W07 - Project-copy risk and priority
description: Study these five words across this week. Complete Flashcards, Matching and Fill in Blank once. Then choose additional practice. Reuse this pool throughout the week. Follow your separate class instructions.

words.definition: A separate copy kept so that information can be recovered if the working copy is lost.
words.example: Keep a backup of the project in a separate location.

words.definition: How likely something is to happen.
words.example: Repeated failed logins increase our concern about the probability of an account attack.

words.definition: The effect or harm caused by a problem.
words.example: A separate backup reduces the impact of losing the working file.

words.definition: Something chosen to be dealt with before other things.
words.example: Protecting the only project copy is our first priority.

words.definition: An action or safeguard that reduces the chance or harm of a problem.
words.example: A separate backup provides protection against losing the only project copy.
